chunks: It has been narrated that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
"Most of the inhabitants of the Fire are the unmarried."

key_terms.أَهْلِ النَّارِ: the people or inhabitants of the Fire
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the unmarried and the Fire?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a statement of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم warning about the condition of the unmarried. It links remaining unmarried with grave spiritual consequence, emphasizing the importance of marriage in moral and religious life.
